NOT_COMPARABLE_TO: NTD operated deadhead (ntd-service-opex-by-mode-timeseries). That series reports what vehicles DID over a year; this reports what a published timetable IMPLIES between revenue trips, excluding pull-out and pull-in entirely. The difference between them is FIRST a definitional gap and only SECOND an operational finding, and this packet cannot say how much is which.
